answer: Locks are logged in spiral, expire in onyx, and sable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 44 aliases hence needs 110 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2399 identities would post 1062 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
